lede: BGK bonds for the COVID-19 Fund (FPC) carry an explicit State Treasury guarantee, i.e. the same credit as POLGBs. Prices are thin Catalyst retail closes (29-30 Dec 2025; FPC0231 last traded 10 Dec), so levels are indicative. Spread vs POLGB = yield minus the fitted POLGB curve for the same cash flows; ASW = yield minus PLN IRS.
takeaways_html: FPC fixed lines trade ~5-32bp over the POLGB curve (average 17bp); widest ASW FPC0235 at 109bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: FPC0229 (+22bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).

Supply known on 31 Dec 2025: BGK's 2026 plan foresees FPC issuance of up to PLN 18.5bn, domestic only (plan reported 24 Sep 2025), after PLN 27.7bn in 2025 (plan amended 15 Oct 2025). The 9 Dec 2025 auction was cancelled because the 27 Nov auction covered the year's needs, so there is no year-end supply overhang.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
sources: Catalyst closes via biznesradar historical pages (29-30 Dec 2025; FPC0231 10 Dec 2025); BGK FPC 2026 plan (reported 24 Sep 2025); FPC 2025 plan amendment (15 Oct 2025); PAP on the cancelled 9 Dec 2025 auction; Pekao market-maker agreement (13 Nov 2025). Yields recomputed with annual ACT/ACT coupons on each bond's anniversary dates.
